external_requirements: Attach a typed OpenShell codex provider; CODEX_AUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN and CODEX_AUTH_ACCOUNT_ID inside the sandbox must be opaque openshell:resolve:env placeholders, never credential values.
Do not copy, upload, mount, reconstruct, or read ~/.codex/auth.json inside the sandbox.
Restrict HTTPS egress to chatgpt.com and bind that endpoint to the admitted Codex executable; the proxy must inspect the request so it can replace placeholders.
Render this provider block into a disposable sandbox CODEX_HOME; keep the host Codex native policy and host login configuration separate.
policy.summary: Codex ChatGPT transport through OpenShell opaque placeholders without copying auth.json into the sandbox.
